 Recalled baby bottle sterilizer dryer could overheat, cause burns
 By Patrick Phillips FOX Local Consumer Published  November 7, 2026 6:47 PM EST Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  November 7, 2026 6:47 PM EST article Three models of the SuperFast Sterilzer Dryer are being recalled because they can overheat, causing a risk of burns. (Photo: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission) 
 The Brief
 The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission announced a recall of roughly 29,000 Baby Brezza SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers because of potential burn risks. 
 Baby Brezza received 32 reports of the units overheating or melting their plastic housing.  
 The recall covers model numbers BRZ0083, BRZ0154, and BRZ0156, which were sold nationwide from January 2024 to October 2026 at TJ Maxx and Marshall’s stores and online via Baby Brezza, Target, and Babylist. 
 The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission is warning parents about a countertop baby bottle and breast pump parts sterilizer and dryer because of a risk that it can overheat and cause burns.
 Big picture view:
 The recall involves roughly 29,000 SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer with model numbers BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156. The model number is printed on the product label located on the bottom of the unit, the CPSC says.
 The recall involves roughly 29,000 SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer with model numbers BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156. The model number is printed on the product label located on the bottom of the unit, the CPSC says. (Photo: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Com 
 Expand They were sold at TJ Maxx and Marshall’s stores nationwide and online at  babybrezza.com ,  target.com and  babylist.com from January 2024 through October of this year for between $160 and $180. 
 The units are designed to sterilize and dry baby bottles, breast pump parts and accessories, but Baby Brezza Enterprises, which issued the recall, received 32 reports of the dryers overheating or the plastic housing melting. No injuries have been reported, CPSC says. 
 What you can do:
 The CPSC is urging customers who have one of the recalled units to stop using it immediately and contact Baby Brezza Enterprises for a free replacement sterilizer dryer, including shipping at no cost to the customer.
 They can call Baby Brezza Enterprises at 888-527-9824 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email  recall@babybrezza.com , or  visit the company’s recall page for more information. 
 Customers will be asked to register online at  babybrezza.com and complete a recall form, unplug the unit and cut the power cord to destroy it and upload photos. 
 The Source: Information for this story came from the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission. This story was reported from Orlando.
